'''Lila Nervi''' was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ralchio Nervi/Legends|Ralchio Nervi]]. The two were married shortly before the latter attended the [[Rengali Imperial Naval Academy]]. A social climber, Ralchio Sargan took [[Gender/Legends|her]] name, and her lobbying helped get him a promotion under [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Ravik/Legends|Ravik]]. It was rumored that the [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] kept [[Prostitute/Legends|mistresses]], however.<ref name="Friends" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lila Nervi is mentioned in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]'s [[roleplaying game]] adventure ''[[Friends Like These]]''.<ref name="Friends" />
